    AtomicSupport - Class in io.github.jabrena.juno.linker

    io.github.jabrena.juno - package io.github.jabrena.juno
    Juno's top-level compiler entry points: the CLI, the embeddable compiler API, and the small value types that connect them.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.analysis - package io.github.jabrena.juno.analysis
    Control-flow structure and conservative resource/runtime-risk analysis over decoded bytecode.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.annotations - package io.github.jabrena.juno.annotations
    Compile-time-only annotations an entry-point class uses to configure Juno's compilation, read directly from the class file rather than at runtime.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api - package io.github.jabrena.juno.api
    The Java-facing hardware API that Juno's compiler recognizes as intrinsics.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.hid - package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.hid
    USB HID mouse control: Mouse, backed by the Arduino Mouse library.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.imu - package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.imu
    Motion sensing: NineAxisMotionShield, the orientation sensor of the Arduino 9 Axis Motion Shield, over I2c.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io - package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io
    General-purpose digital/analog I/O: Gpio, the raw pin-number operations (pinMode/digitalWrite/digitalRead/ analogRead/analogWrite/toggle), and DigitalOutput, a zero-cost handle bound to one output pin (high/low/toggle/isHigh) for callers that prefer an object-shaped API over passing a pin number to every call.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.i2c - package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.i2c
    I2C register access: I2c reads and writes the registers of a peripheral on the board's primary I2C bus.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.ir - package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.ir
    Infrared serial transport: Infrared bit-bangs framed bytes over a 38 kHz IR receiver module and an IR LED on plain pins.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.serial - package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.serial
    USB serial output: Serial and its BaudRate constants.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.lcd - package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.lcd
    Drivers for character LCD shields, currently LcdKeypadShield: a 16x2 HD44780-compatible display in 4-bit mode plus 5 buttons read from a single resistor-ladder analog pin, wired for the shield's standard pinout.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.led - package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.led
    The UNO R4 WiFi's built-in 12x8 LED matrix: LedMatrix, the raw compiler-intrinsic begin/loadFrame/clear operations, and LedCanvas, a boolean[HEIGHT][MAX_WIDTH] pixel buffer with shape and text drawing helpers that render into it and send it to the hardware with show.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.lego - package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.lego
    LEGO Powered Up hubs over Bluetooth LE: PoweredUpHubRemote, backed by the Arduino ArduinoBLE library, and the LEGO Mindstorms RCX infrared remote protocol: RcxRemote and, for its sensors, RcxBrick, and Scout brick commands in ScoutRemote, plus the Power Functions IR receiver in PowerFunctionsRemote; the three infrared classes are built on Infrared.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.motors - package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.motors
     
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.net - package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.net
    WiFi connectivity for the Arduino UNO R4 WiFi and UNO Q: Wifi connects and reads the board's address, while Udp provides allocation-free discovery, send, and receive primitives.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.net.email - package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.net.email
    Basic SMTP send / POP3S read built on Wifi's connection: Smtp to send a plain-text message to one recipient, and Pop3Client to report the mailbox message count and read the newest message's From/Subject and a bounded plain-text body into caller-owned buffers.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.net.http - package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.net.http
    HTTP(S) client and server support built on Wifi's connection: HttpClient/HttpsClient to send requests into a caller-owned byte[] response buffer, Json to read typed values directly out of a response buffer without building a parsed document, and HttpServer (plain HTTP only) to serve requests, with HttpMethod/HttpStatus as named constants for both directions.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.tft - package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.tft
    Drivers for TFT display shields, currently TftTouchShield: the ELEGOO 2.8" 240x320 ILI9341 display on an 8-bit parallel bus, with a resistive touch panel and a microSD socket (read through SdCard).
    io.github.jabrena.juno.backend - package io.github.jabrena.juno.backend
    Code generation: turns optimized Juno IR into a complete Arduino sketch for any supported board (the Cortex-M4 UNO R4 WiFi and the Cortex-M33 UNO Q).
    io.github.jabrena.juno.board - package io.github.jabrena.juno.board
    Juno's model of a compilation target: Board, resolved from the entry-point class's @Board annotation (see Board) via Board.fromApiClassName(String), or Board.DEFAULT when the entry point carries none.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.bytecode - package io.github.jabrena.juno.bytecode
    Decodes the intentionally small JVM bytecode subset Juno v0.1 supports.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.classfile - package io.github.jabrena.juno.classfile
    Reads standard JVM class files and resolves their constant-pool references, independent of Juno's own bytecode subset or IR.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.intrinsic - package io.github.jabrena.juno.intrinsic
    The closed catalog of hardware operations Juno understands, independent of any particular Java method signature or Arduino-side lowering.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.ir - package io.github.jabrena.juno.ir
    Juno's own intermediate representation: a non-SSA, block-structured form that lowering produces from JVM bytecode, optimize transforms, and backend consumes to generate assembly.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.linker - package io.github.jabrena.juno.linker
    Closed-world reachability: starting at main, follows every statically resolvable call, resolves hardware intrinsics and record accessors, and rejects anything reachable that falls outside Juno's supported subset — before any code generation is attempted.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.lowering - package io.github.jabrena.juno.lowering
    Lowers linked, reachable JVM bytecode into Juno's IR.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.optimize - package io.github.jabrena.juno.optimize
    IR-to-IR optimization passes run between lowering and the backend.

    LedMatrixFontAscii - Class in io.github.jabrena.juno.api.led
    A 5x7 dot-matrix font covering the full printable ASCII range (32 space .. 126 ~), for printing arbitrary ASCII characters on the UNO R4 WiFi's 12x8 LED matrix one at a time (two glyphs fit side by side: 5 + 1 gap + 5 = 11 of the 12 columns), and for the TFT shield's text.
    LedMatrixFontSmall - Class in io.github.jabrena.juno.api.led
    A compact 3x5 dot-matrix font for digits 0-9, offered as a smaller alternative to the 5x7 LedMatrixFont (which it does not replace).
